verdict.rationale: fido2-manage is an official, open-source command-line tool (with optional GUI) built on libfido2 that scriptably manages FIDO2 devices: setting/changing PINs, resident credential (passkey) management, biometric enrollment, SSH key provisioning, and dumping device info/relying parties to JSON/CSV for auditing — covering enable/configure, PIN, slot-like credential management, and state reads. missing for 10: no explicit 'enable application/slot' terminology (Yubikey-style applet toggling) and no independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor's own GitHub docs.
